context: Tests whether the agent strips padding from an AI-sounding update while keeping every fact and link intact.

checklist.name: Cuts transitions
checklist.description: The rewrite removes transition words such as Moreover, Additionally, Furthermore, and Nevertheless instead of swapping in synonyms.

checklist.name: Replaces corporate verbs
checklist.description: Corporate verbs such as leveraged, facilitate, utilized, optimize, strategizing are gone or replaced with plain verbs like use, help, build, plan.

checklist.name: Removes hedges and filler openers
checklist.description: Hedges such as various, numerous, a number of, and throat-clearing such as 'It's important to note' and 'I wanted to provide a comprehensive update' are removed.

checklist.name: Removes filler closer
checklist.description: The closing lines 'Let me know if you have any questions', 'don't hesitate to reach out', and 'Hope this helps' are cut, not rephrased.

checklist.name: Keeps all numbers and dates
checklist.description: All figures survive unchanged: 14 services, 22 minutes, 9 minutes, March 14, 48-hour.

checklist.name: Keeps names and links
checklist.description: Priya Raman, Marcus Webb, the [[EKS]] wiki-link, and the https://wiki.example.com/redwood-runbook URL all appear unchanged.

checklist.name: Keeps the writer's point
checklist.description: The update still reports the migration progress, the build time win, and the database cutover risk without adding new claims.
